info.title: Redundant_Management
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

comm_ip_addr.description: Source IP address for the interface port used for communication between management modules. The IP address can be either in the IPv4 format or IPv6 format (uses '[' and ']' around the IP address). The IP address can include the protocol and port number to be used, using ':' separators.   Example: tcp:[0123::4567:89ab:cdef:0123%eth1]:1234

comm_mac_addr.description: Source Ethernet MAC address for the interface port used for communication between management modules.

hardware_revision.description: Hardware revision of the management module is used to ensure  the compatibility with redundant management.

is_local.description: Indicates which management module this redundant management  module entry belongs to.  `true`: belongs to the local management module `false`: belongs to the remote management module

mgmt_module.description:
Reference Resource: [Subsystem](#/Subsystem)
Management module entry associated with a given redundant management module entry.

mgmt_role.description: Management role assigned to the management module. `Active`:     Active management module `Standby`:    Standby management module, ready to takeover for                Active management module `Unassigned`: Management module has not been assigned a role

name.description:
Reference Resource: [Redundant_Management](#/Redundant_Management)
Name of the management module. Can be any unique string identifying the management module (e.g. Could include slot number or slot letter).

remote_present.description: Status of the physical presence of the destination management module.

software_revision.description: Software revision of the management module is used to ensure  the compatibility with redundant management.

state.description: The current state of the management role. Valid values are:  `booting`:       The module is booting or rebooting. `election`:      The election process is taking place. `failover`:      A failover event is occurring. `ready`:         The management role is ready. `syncing`:       A file or data syncing operation is in progress. `issu`:          The module is undergoing an in service system upgrade. `sync_canceled`: The module's image is not compatible with remote MM hardware. `waiting_ready`: The module is waiting to proceed to the ready state. `unknown`:       The role state is currently unknown.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
